_meta.title: F-003 mobile-surface QA fixtures
_meta.scope: Mobile-only test data: the enumerated permission matrix, the lifecycle scenarios, and the test-data namespace. Nothing else.

not_here.utterance_intent_table: docs/qa/assistant/F-001/api/utterance-intent-fixtures.json — the canonical table is READ, never copied. L-004 records what happens when a spec-declared canonical artifact gets a hand-kept twin: the copies diverge by one row and both sides invent local workarounds that pass. Mobile TCs name canonical row ids; they do not restate rows.
not_here.selector_catalogue: docs/design/assistant/screens/voice-assistant-view-{ios,android}.html — the 22 ids are PARSED from the mockups at test time by the automation, never hand-listed here. Per L-002, a hand-copied catalogue turns a contract check into a self-agreement check.

users.note: One account per TC (per sub-case where a TC drives several). Server state is scoped per X-User-Id, so two TCs may safely reuse the same canonical task title. Seeded task titles carry the qamob- prefix wherever the canonical utterance lets QA choose the title.
users.isolation: _qa-foundations §10 — qa-api-agent uses qaapi-, qa-web-agent uses qaweb-, qa-mobile-agent uses qamob-. No unscoped destructive operation is permitted in any mobile TC.

permission_matrix._note: Enumerated, not sampled (F-003 ## Test strategy (mobile)). iOS ×4 + Android ×3 + no-capability + transient ×2. Every row has its own P1 TC — a matrix collapsed into one sampled test cannot distinguish the dimmed/hidden boundary or the denied/permanently-denied split.

lifecycle_scenarios._note: Kill is simulated at the port boundary: a DurableStore double whose contents survive constructing a fresh model instance. That is the ACs' stated observable (F-003 ## Test strategy (mobile)). A real OS kill is device-lab debt.

executed for the first time on replay — exactly once
cancel-while-listening; audio session released; mic returns without re-prompt
GET /assistant/session is the FIRST request; session resumes visibly
exactly ONE boundary message, then clean start; not re-rendered on a second foreground
mic stays AVAILABLE — offline alone never dims or hides it
recognized text lands in the composer → local no-AI path; zero /assistant/* calls; offline banner renders
queued notice visible; replay under the SAME client_turn_id; effect appears once; store cleared on ack
